title: New Song Spotlight
description: This week's spotlight is Marc Cohn's “Walking in Memphis” — the 1991 roots-pop classic about a young songwriter who gets baptized in the music of Beale Street, from the ghost of Elvis at the Hollywood cafe to the choir that “alright” every line he sings. It's a warm, storytelling groove that rolls on a gospel-soul piano pulse and a chorus built for rooms to light up on. In a Djembe set it lands as the nostalgic, uplifting heartbeat of the night — a song that sounds like a place before it ever sounds like a hit.
songListNote: Song of the Week — Marc Cohn's warm roots-pop classic “Walking in Memphis” joins the request catalog this week.
